parsed.title: Unlock Image Generation Credit
parsed.oneLiner: Watch a quick mini-game with Luzia to earn an AI image generation credit.

newMechanic.name: Rewarded Image Credits
newMechanic.description: Users can watch or play a mini-game to earn an image generation credit when they hit their AI usage quota.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Allows free users to continue generating images without impacting paid conversion by limiting the reward to a single credit per view.

parsed.trigger: When user attempts to generate an image in the Image Creation Hub and their AI Usage Quota (r3) is depleted.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users who have exhausted their free AI Usage Quota (r3).

offer.title: Earn an image credit
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with Luzia to get 1 free AI image generation credit.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Limited to 3 credits per day and only available when r3 is depleted; ensures non-payers maintain usage without unlimited free generation.

kpis.holdout: 10% of non-paying user base held out for 4 weeks.

risks: Ad saturation if limits are too frequent
Brand safety concerns in AI-generated images
Potential for lower paid conversion if reward is too generous

evidence.quote: Mix or swap elements from photos

newScreens.change: Rewarded ad invitation modal for image credit.

newElements.change: Button to trigger rewarded ad for 1 image credit when limit is reached.
